presentation.title: 👋 Hello, I'm Florent
presentation.subtitle: Software Engineer specialized in .NET backend and DevOps
presentation.seekingJobBanner: Seeking a permanent position (CDI) in the PACA region starting September 2026 — Toulon · Marseille · Aix-en-Provence
presentation.firstParagraph1: Passionate about software architecture, I am currently a software engineer with a strong focus on Backend (.NET/C#) and DevOps.
presentation.firstParagraph2: I built my technical foundation through an IT University Diploma (BUT) followed by a Master's in Cloud Computing at INSSET, a program entirely completed as an apprentice at Orange Business.
presentation.firstParagraph3: Designing APIs and clean architectures is what drives me on a daily basis.
presentation.secondParagraph: I approach my projects with a comprehensive view of the software lifecycle: from pure backend development to deployment automation, thanks to a solid DevOps and Cloud culture (CI/CD, containerization). My knowledge of Vue.js complements this approach by giving me the overall vision needed to collaborate effectively with frontend teams.
presentation.philosophyText: Before typing a single line of code, I make sure to fully understand the business needs and the final goal. I design the database architecture and API contracts first, then build it block by block with clean, testable, and maintainable code. When facing a bug, I don't use a band-aid — I trace it to its source, fix the flaw, and write a test to ensure it never comes back.
presentation.goalText:
At the end of my studies, in September 2026, I will return to Provence to be closer to my family and build the next steps of my career there.

Having developed a solid expertise and a strong affinity for the Microsoft ecosystem and automation, I am actively seeking a permanent role as a .NET Developer or DevOps Engineer.

My goal is to join a stimulating technical team in Toulon, Aix-en-Provence, or Marseille, where I can design robust backend architectures, ensure infrastructure reliability through CI/CD, and contribute to ambitious projects where code quality is paramount.
presentation.goalCTA: Seeking .NET / DevOps CDI (Toulon, Aix, Marseille) — starting Sept. 2026

tuuuur.title: Tuuuur
tuuuur.shortDescription: Cross-platform Quiz Application (Web & Mobile) - Cloud Computing Master's Project.
tuuuur.description: Tuuuur is a cross-platform quiz app designed to combine entertainment, learning, and competition through multiplayer lobbies and competitive duels.
tuuuur.context: Thematic project carried out as part of the Cloud Computing & Mobility Master's degree (UPJV). Team: 3-person project with Gaël Grosset and Killian Lefrancois.
tuuuur.roles: Project Manager, Designer, Cloud Architect (GCP) and Back-End / DB Developer.
tuuuur.concept: Tuuuur features multiplayer lobbies (generated via QR Code), 1v1 competitive duels (with health points and multipliers), as well as a solo practice mode.

homelab.title: HomeLab — Personal Server
homelab.shortDescription: Repurposing an old PC into a personal server: Proxmox virtualization, IPFire secure network, WireGuard VPN, and self-hosted services.
homelab.description: Repurposing an old PC into a server hosting a complete infrastructure: Proxmox hypervisor, IPFire firewall, WireGuard VPN, NGINX reverse proxy, and a dozen self-hosted services (Jellyfin, Nextcloud, Immich, Pterodactyl...), all secured via RAID.
homelab.context: Personal project born from a dual desire: to take full control of my data and to deepen my system administration, virtualization, and network security skills learned in class. Rather than letting an old PC collect dust, I transformed it into a genuine personal server.
homelab.roles: System Administrator · Network Architect · DevOps Engineer
homelab.concept: A complete homelab driven by Proxmox VE as the central hypervisor, with an internal network fully segmented and secured by IPFire (firewall/router). Data is protected by RAID for fault tolerance. Remote access is secured via a WireGuard VPN, and all services are cleanly exposed through NGINX Proxy Manager with automatic SSL certificates.

infrastructure.heading: Infrastructure & Virtualization (Proxmox)
items: Installing and configuring Proxmox VE as the main hypervisor on a repurposed PC
Creating and managing VMs and LXC containers to isolate each service independently
Setting up a RAID for data redundancy and disk fault tolerance

network.heading: Network & Security
items: Deploying IPFire as a firewall and router to segment and secure the internal network
Configuring a WireGuard VPN for encrypted and secure access from the outside
Setting up NGINX Proxy Manager as a centralized reverse proxy with automatic SSL/TLS (Let's Encrypt)

services.heading: Self-Hosted Services
items: Jellyfin: media server for managing and streaming movies and series
Nextcloud: personal cloud for file storage and synchronization
Immich: managing, organizing, and backing up personal photo libraries
Pterodactyl + Wings: administration panel for multi-instance game servers

security.heading: Security & Service Isolation
items: Strict network segmentation via IPFire to prevent any unauthorized communication between services
SSL/TLS certificate management and secure exposure of public services via reverse proxy

reliability.heading: Reliability & Maintenance
items: Implementing RAID to guarantee service continuity in the event of a disk failure
Regularly monitoring and updating each service to maintain overall stability and security
